answer: Duplicate plots are rejected, so faking identities means acquiring costly land. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce real-world asset: each agent must lock a unique plot in a verified community garden registry, with coordinates checked against satellite imagery. Reputation then flows like a tide across the ocean of peers, and honest agents forge durable trust while attackers burn capital on plots they can never reuse. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
